post.summary:
Reads a nutrition label photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 10 MB) into a prefilled food form, with the fields
to confirm marked. The photo is processed in memory and not stored. Nothing is saved: the user confirms the
values and creates the food through POST /api/foods.

ScanResultDto.description:
The prefill for the "Add food" form. With NutriScan.Application.Common.Models.OcrStatus.Unavailable every field is null and
NutriScan.Application.Scans.Dtos.ScanResultDto.Message tells the user to fill the form by hand (NFR-12).

StatisticsDto.description:
FR-08 over a range. NutriScan.Application.Statistics.Dtos.StatisticsDto.Average, NutriScan.Application.Statistics.Dtos.StatisticsDto.Deviation and NutriScan.Application.Statistics.Dtos.StatisticsDto.CaloriesDeviationPercent
cover logged days only and are null when there are none (ADR-009 D2).
